cli.adminResetNotPermitted: This installation''s database credential could not be read. Run this as the user that installed Sennard, on this computer.
cli.adminResetFailed: The reset did not complete and nothing was changed: {cause}
cli.adminResetSettingsLocked: Another process holds this installation''s settings database (the server may still be shutting down, or it started again). Nothing was changed. Run the command again.
cli.adminResetServerStopped: The Sennard server of this installation was running, so the command stopped it to open the settings database. The next hook call starts it again.
cli.adminResetDatabaseUnreachable: Could not connect to this installation''s database. Make the database reachable and run the command again. {cause}
cli.alreadyInstalled: Sennard is already installed in {root}. Use: sennard upgrade (or sennard uninstall first).
cli.deleteFailed: Could not remove {folder}: {cause}. If a program of Sennard still runs from that folder (for example a host''s MCP server), close it and run the command again.
cli.downgradeRefused: This release is {version} and the installed version is {installed}.
cli.hookOptionInvalid#problem=other: {option} has a value that cannot be read: {value}
cli.hostFilesFailed: Could not place the hook files: {cause}
cli.hostHooksNotReached: The {host} plugin is loaded in place from a folder that Sennard does not change, so its hooks and its MCP server do not run this installation''s programs ({launcher}): {targets}. Copy this installation''s definition from {definitions} into each of those files, or install the plugin from a marketplace that is not a local folder, then run the hooks command again.
cli.hostIdInvalid: The file {file} does not hold a UUID. Delete the file; the server makes a new identity when it needs one.
cli.installFailed#what=trainingInputUnre: Could not read the AOT training input {file}.
cli.installFailed#what=copyFailed: Could not copy the application to {folder}.
cli.installFailed#what=temporaryFolderFa: Could not make a temporary folder for the AOT training.
cli.installRootNotRepresentable: The installation folder {root} cannot be written in this system''s file name encoding, which the java command line uses. Set SENNARD_INSTALL_ROOT to a folder that can be written in it.
cli.javaExecutableUnknown: The JVM did not report the java program it runs from, so the commands of the hooks and the server cannot be written. Run the command with the java of a JDK that is started by its full path.
cli.jvmPresetUnknown#problem=notAPreset: The preset {value} in {file} is not one of {presets}.
cli.jvmPresetUnknown#problem=missing: There is no preset in {file}; it is one of {presets}.
cli.jvmPresetUnknown#problem=other: The preset in {file} is not one of {presets}.
cli.memoryUnknown: The JVM did not report the machine''s memory ({total}), so the server''s JVM preset cannot be chosen. Write the preset to {file} (sennard.jvm.preset, one of {presets}) and run the command again.
cli.notAReleaseJar: Run this from the release jar: java -jar sennard-<version>.jar <command>.
cli.notInstalled#what=upgrade: Nothing to upgrade in {root}. Use: sennard install
cli.notInstalled#what=other: Sennard is not installed in {root}. Use: sennard install
cli.serverAlreadyRunning: Another Sennard server already runs on this state folder. Only one server runs on a state folder.
cli.serverUnreachable: No server of this installation answers: {where}
cli.startFailed#what=otherStartPending: Another start of the server was not done within {seconds}s.
cli.startFailed#what=notReady: The server was not ready within {seconds}s; its address file is {file}.
cli.startFailed#what=notHealthy: The server did not become healthy; its address file is {file}. See: sennard status
cli.stateDirNotRepresentable: The state folder cannot be written in this system''s file name encoding, which the java command line uses. Set SENNARD_STATE_DIR instead, or write sennard.state-dir in sennard.yaml.
cli.stopFailed#what=shutdownRefused: The server (address file {file}) did not accept the shutdown request.
cli.stopFailed#what=processHeld: The server process {pid} did not end.
cli.storePreparationFailed: The store could not be prepared: {reason}. After fixing the cause, run: sennard prepare --retry
cli.storePreparationTimeout: The store was not ready within the time allowed. See: sennard status
cli.uninstallFromInstalledCopy: {running} runs from inside {root}, which is being removed, so nothing was changed. Run this from a copy of the release jar outside {root}.
